title: [Performance][EPLB] Skip unchanged layers in async transfer cycles
body:
## Summary

- Skip async EPLB weight transfers for layers whose physical-to-logical expert mapping is unchanged.
- Mark the final changed layer explicitly so a cycle no longer depends on the model's physical last layer.
- Publish a no-transfer completion result when every layer is unchanged, preserving the existing cross-rank/main-thread acknowledgement path.

Fixes #51791.

## Root cause and impact

The async worker previously iterated over every MoE layer after rebalancing. Even when a layer's mapping was unchanged, it still performed the coordinated stop check, entered `transfer_layer()`, synchronized the CUDA stream, published a result, and waited for acknowledgement. Sparse mapping changes therefore cost `O(L)` layer handshakes instead of `O(K)`, where `K` is the number of changed layers.

## Purpose

Add an SM100 CuTe DSL BF16 packed gate/up GEMM with a register-only SiLU or SiTU epilogue for the unquantized, non-sequence-parallel Kimi K3 MLP path.

For packed weights `[2I, K]` and activations `[T, K]`, the kernel computes:

```text
gate = X @ W_gate.T
up   = X @ W_up.T
```

```text
SiLU: output = gate * sigmoid(gate) * up
```

SiTU: output = beta * tanh(gate / beta) * sigmoid(gate)
